messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api: request_queue_size for gpu-pool-hosted spiked to 58k; p95 latency > 6s, p99 ~ 18s, 504 rate rising (svc: /v1/generate). threshold breached for 5m. Investigate.
pagerduty: Paging maya (oncall) — pagerduty incident #INC-8942.
maya (oncall): ack — jumping in. any notes on traffic source?
samira (infra): I'm seeing a traffic burst from a handful of keys — top 3 keys account for ~65% of queued requests. Also: autoscaler logs show it hit max_replicas=12 for gpu-pool-hosted around T-7m.
maya (oncall): copy. are there any recent policy changes to max_replicas?
ken (platform): quick check — there was a cost-safety change from last week that lowered hosted GPU max from 30 -> 12 in region eu-west-1 via pr #4123. It was intended for night windows but rollout targeted wrong pool (applied to gpu-pool-hosted).
maya (oncall): ugh. that explains hitting cap. can we manually override?
samira (infra): trying a manual scale now to 20 replicas, but cloud provider reports insufficient quota in eu-west-1. Request returns: 
```
ERROR: quota_exceeded: Requested cores unavailable
Autoscaler aborted scale-up
```

samira (infra): Also seeing increased evictions and pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff for a couple of retry attempts — likely because concurrent scale-ups kicked too many node provisioning jobs.
emily (support): customers reporting timeouts: "payments-service" and "chatflow" flagged 504s, both premium. Support has opened tickets.
maya (oncall): priority: reduce user-facing 504s. Options: 1) reroute heavy keys to dedicated/different region 2) apply token-level rate limits 3) degrade model to a smaller variant to free GPU time 4) enable graceful rejection (429) for non-critical traffic. Which is fastest?
ken (platform): fastest is routing top keys to dedicated routing if they have Dedicated flagged. Otherwise rate limiting + model downgrade is quickest. I can flip routing for keys that have 'dedicated' tag in ~2m.
jonathan (next-oncall): I can take the handoff in 15m, but can help with testing routing change now.
samira (infra): we have 2 immediate levers: a) update routing policy to send keys X/Y/Z to dedicated-pool-us-east (if available) b) modify autoscaler max_replicas to a temporary emergency cap 25 in other regions and try cross-region routing. I'll start (a) for keys with Dedicated=true.
maya (oncall): do it. For keys without dedicated, we should rate-limit. emily, can you identify top non-dedicated keys causing load?
emily (support): pulling list from metrics — keys: key_ab12 (non-dedicated), key_cf55 (non-dedicated), key_z9pq (dedicated). key_ab12 is generating long streaming requests from a bot spike.
ken (platform): flipping routing for key_z9pq -> dedicated-pool-us-east now. Command: 
```
POST /admin/routing
{ "api_key": "key_z9pq", "target_pool": "dedicated-pool-us-east" }
```

ops-bot: routing change applied for key_z9pq, new route propagated to edge in 38s.
samira (infra): routing applied. saw immediate drop in queued requests for that key. total queue fell from 58k -> 41k in 2m. p95 improved to ~4.2s.
maya (oncall): good. next: for key_ab12, apply temporary per-key rate limit 15 r/s and fallback to smaller model. ken, can you push the rate limit rule?
ken (platform): applying rate limit for key_ab12 and key_cf55: 
```
PATCH /admin/rate-limits
{ "api_keys": ["key_ab12","key_cf55"], "limit_rps": 15, "duration": 1800 }
```

ops-bot: rate limit rule applied. New responses for excessive requests will return 429.
samira (infra): also pushing a model-fallback policy for high-cost routes: requests over 60s token budget will be routed to model:redwood-small. Command: 
```
PUT /admin/fallbacks
{ "condition": "cost>60s", "fallback_model": "redwood-small" }
```

ops-bot: fallback policy active.
maya (oncall): monitoring.
(2m monitor pass)
maya (oncall): queue now 22k, p95 ~3.1s, p99 ~8.0s, 504s trend declining. Good. Any remaining hotspots?
emily (support): payments-service still has elevated errors but reduced. Customers notified and support posted temporary mitigation steps.
jonathan (next-oncall): I'm taking over the incident log. maya handing to me in 10m. Any remaining manual actions for night shift?
maya (oncall): leave the routing and rate limits in place for now. samira, can infra open emergency quota request for eu-west-1 and start provisioning warm nodes in us-east as cross-region buffer?
samira (infra): opening cloud support case now and requesting temporary burst quota. Provisioning warm nodes in us-east; expected ready in ~12-20m.
ken (platform): also rolling back the accidental max_replicas change from pr #4123 for gpu-pool-hosted. I'll create a targeted revert to restore to 30 for hosted-only pools.
(ops-bot logs): revert PR initiated: #4188-revert-pr4123.
maya (oncall): status update for incident: Severity: S2 (service degradation, partial customer impact). Impact: increased p95/p99 and 504s for hosted API; highest-traffic non-dedicated keys were rate-limited; two premium customers saw transient errors; no data loss. Mitigation: routing heavy keys to Dedicated, applied per-key rate limits, activated fallback to smaller model, manual revert of autoscale limit in progress, cloud quota requested.
emily (support): sent status update to affected customers and posted workaround guidance.
jonathan (next-oncall): taking over now — I have context. maya, handoff notes?
maya (oncall): handoff: think about longer-term: 1) audit automated PRs touching autoscaler caps with more gating 2) add playbook that maps heavy API keys to dedicated fallbacks 3) implement an emergency-override for scale when quota available 4) postmortem owner: samira. I'll stay on pagerduty standby for any questions.
jonathan (next-oncall): ack — I'll monitor for the next 2 hours and coordinate with infra. samira, please update this thread when quota or new nodes are ready.
samira (infra): quota case updated: support requested temporary +40 GPUs in eu-west-1; provider responded with ETA 4h for quota; meanwhile warm nodes in us-east are ready in 14m.
jonathan (next-oncall): noted. We should reduce blast radius: plan to keep per-key rate limits and fallback until autoscaling fully validated and quota stable. Also adding a temporary banner in Console: "Performance degradation in eu-west-1 — routing/fallbacks active."
ken (platform): banner deployed.
(2h later)
samira (infra): quick followup — cloud granted burst capacity in eu-west-1, added 24 GPUs; autoscaler now able to scale to 28 replicas. Observed tail latency returning to normal after scale-up.
jonathan (next-oncall): marking incident as mitigated. We'll keep the rate limits and fallbacks until tomorrow AM and cutover after full postmortem. Creating postmortem doc and assigning samira as owner.
emily (support): will update customers with final mitigation note.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-8942 mitigated at 1769003398.
jonathan (next-oncall): closing thread for now. Postmortem request: timeline + root cause: misapplied autoscaler cap PR + insufficient region quota + lack of key-to-dedicated mapping. Action items: revert PR (ken), postmortem (samira), playbook (maya), improve PR gating (platform).
samira (infra): acknowledged, will draft postmortem and link to this thread.
maya (oncall): thanks everyone. :tada:
jonathan (next-oncall): thanks team.
